name: FENDERSHOT
description:
About This Game

Old-School Arcade Street Racing

Inspired by classic arcade racers from the 00s, fused with some outrageous Race Tech™. Street vibes? Check. Tight arcade handling? Check. Mad sense of speed? Check. Underglow neons? Check. Traffic check? Honk honk. Turbo flutter? Sh-tutututu!

Local Multiplayer, Co-op Campaign

Remember this long-lost thing called split-screen? Welcome it back, and some friends too! Tackle the entire campaign solo or with 2-4 players on the couch. Or just mess around together in quick race, challenges or free practice. Enter additional crew events that are exclusive to split-screen. Co-op might be recommended for victory, but remember, you're under no obligation to cooperate 😈

Take on the fiercest rivals

The FENDERSHOT Street Racing League ain't your summer racing festival. Your rivals are savage, relentless and brutal. Pick your best loadout, and bring your race face on. Or just hang out on the track and mess with them in practice.

Other cool stuff

  • Tight responsive physics, on driving as well as combat

  • More than just racing: Drift, Speedtrap, Gauntlet, Target Practice and more

  • Race Tech™: Bolts, shockwaves, mines, rams and more await your loadout

  • Play your way: Don't like the Race Tech™or traffic? Turn it on or off based on however you wanna play.

  • Controls tuned for both gamepad and keyboard (although gamepad is recommended)

  • Hella optimized: Butter-smooth gameplay on Steam Deck, and that's a promise!
short_desc: Old-school street racing meets car combat. Soaked in 2000s vibes. And a wild sense of speed. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Test drive the demo on PC, Mac and SteamOS (Proton)!
